releases.body:
Tavily quota reliability and compatibility:
- OpenCode 2.2.3, @opencode/plugin 2.2.3, OpenTUI 0.8, theme 2.2.3
- server-side quota cache scoped by credential, persisted across restarts
- cross-process locking so separate servers share one request budget
- Retry-After/429 cooldown, 65s minimum interval, safe forced refresh
- PAYG and missing-usage handling, null payload guard, label width fix
- refreshMs validation, credential-change invalidation, last-snapshot retention
- RPC contract/types exports, docs in package, clean install fix

95 tests passing.

Renamed the package to `opencode-tavily-quota` (dropping the `@cardinal4` scope) and moved npm publishing to GitHub Actions using OIDC trusted publishing.

Install: `opencode plugin add opencode-tavily-quota`
